title: Pane tree layout owned by Rust, presets shape with app ids not instance ids
context: Layout state must be shared across windows for drag-and-drop. Instance ids are session-local; app ids are permanent types.
decision: Rust owns all layout: PaneNode uses instance ids (session-specific identity), PresetNode uses app ids (portable arrangement). Presets mirror Rust structure without any identity.
consequences: User can save an arrangement of surfaces and restore it with new sessions. Tabs can be dragged across windows from the same Rust-owned state.
